programmes.amount_note: Micro-loan of EUR 2,500 to EUR 50,000, term 6 months to 4 years, interest at the EU reference rate (ECB base rate plus a margin depending on rating and collateral). Also available to businesses without a trading history.

eligibility.other_note: Micro and small entrepreneurs with up to 50 employees and turnover up to EUR 10 million; also social enterprises; no business history required; liabilities to the state must be settled and a realistic business plan with repayment ability shown.

programmes.source_snippet: Minimálna výška mikropôžičky je € 2 500, maximálna výška je € 50 000; Doba splatnosti je stanovená od 6 mesiacov do 4 rokov.

programmes.amount_note: Free or subsidised incubation, mentoring and expert services for Slovak startups; predominantly in-kind.

Innovation vouchers under de minimis scheme DM-18/2024 (national project ZIVSE 2). Example call (dual-use technologies): voucher EUR 3,000 to EUR 30,000, aid intensity up to 85% of eligible costs, max once per applicant. Ceiling set per call.
programmes.deadline_note: SIEA runs thematic calls through the INOWA portal; the page lists current calls (EIC Accelerator advisory vouchers; patents and certification) and calls for robotics/automation (from 12 Jan 2026) and dual-use technologies (from 1 Apr 2026) under closed calls. Check inowa.siea.sk for the open window.

eligibility.other_note: Natural or legal persons registered and doing business in Slovakia, any size; registered seat in Slovakia; startups may submit a business plan instead of accounts; no voucher previously reimbursed under other ZIVSE 2 calls.

programmes.source_snippet: Výška pomoci de minimis v rámci tejto Inovačnej poukážky priamou formou je minimálne 3 000 eur a maximálne 30 000 eur s intenzitou pomoci maximálne 85 % z celkových oprávnených výdavkov
